items.question: What does the chapter state in the source passage beginning “Your first stop is Kannauj, a city by River Ganga where…”?
items.answer: Your first stop is Kannauj, a city by River Ganga where a powerful king hosts poets and scholars.

items.question: What does the chapter state in the source passage beginning “A few of the more powerful kingdoms rose to the status…”?
items.answer: A few of the more powerful kingdoms rose to the status of empires, but rarely managed to cover a large part of India or to last more than a couple of centuries.
